title: Etherfields
subtitle: A surreal cooperative narrative dream-crawler uncovering buried subconscious secrets
tagline: Step beyond reality, solve surreal riddles, and reclaim your lost memories.
loreSummary: You awake as a nameless Dreamer trapped inside an ever-shifting labyrinth of subconscious visions. Trapped between slumbers and bizarre dreamscapes, you must confront repressed traumas, wear enigmatic masks, and uncover why you are trapped in this surreal realm.
keyFeatures: Surreal 'Dream Crawler' structure blending deck manipulation and escape-room style riddles
Persistent subconscious world map connecting dynamic Slumbers and deep thematic Dreams
Streamlined 2.0 Campaign Rules refining progression, slumber tempo, and memory restoration
Enigmatic masks and character progression shaping your psychological identity

etherfields_grand.name: Grand Dreamscapes & Secrets
